54b9801a4cf8665f.description: The Methods Manager is accountable for the development, governance, and implementation of construction methodologies for the project, ensuring that works are executed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with the project design, program, and site constraints. Reporting to the Technical Director, the role provides construction methodology leadership, acting as the technical bridge between design, engineering, planning, and site execution. The Senior Methods Engineering Manager owns construction sequencing, temporary works strategy, buildability reviews, and method approval processes, ensuring that approved designs are translated into safe, practical, and executable construction methods. DUTIES PREFORMED % of Time Key Accountabilities Key Activities 30% Construction Methodology & Temporary works design Develop, manage, and oversee construction methodologies and sequencing strategies, including the design and coordination of all associated temporary and enabling works for both underground and above-ground structures, ensuring alignment with approved permanent works design and site-specific conditions. Formulate cost-effective construction approaches and detailed lifting plans for heavy lifts involving specialized precast concrete units and structural steel elements, with strong expertise in modular and off-site construction techniques. Identify repetitive construction processes and implement optimized methodologies, including the appropriate selection of tools, equipment, and lifting accessories, to enhance productivity, shorten cycle times, and achieve project schedule and cost efficiencies. Liaise with and support project teams in the adoption and implementation of MMC (Modern Methods of Construction) across multiple project sites. Demonstrate strong knowledge of geotechnical parameters and their impact on the design and performance of temporary and enabling works. Propose, develop, and coordinate with specialist designers on deep excavation solutions, including slope stability assessments, shoring systems, and temporary earth-retaining structures required to support safe and efficient construction. Define access arrangements, logistics planning, lifting strategies, temporary works concepts, and construction staging. Lead constructability and buildability reviews in collaboration with Design Managers, construction teams, and subcontractors to enhance execution efficiency, improve practicality of design solutions, and minimize construction risks. Provide expert construction methodology input to support value engineering initiatives, evaluate alternative construction approaches, and develop effective risk mitigation strategies. 25% Design Coordination (D&B Interface) Act as the technical interface between Design, Engineering, BIM, and site execution teams. Review design deliverables for constructability, including temporary formwork and permanent structure drawings. Review and provide Temporary works Bill of quantities for planning and budgeting. 20% Safety, Risk & Compliance Ensure all construction methodologies are fully compliant with HSE requirements, applicable statutory regulations, client standards, and internal company procedures. Lead and support risk assessments, lifting studies, constructability hazard reviews, and temporary works risk evaluations. Embed safety-by-design and safety-by-methodology principles into all construction planning and execution strategies. Support permit-to-work systems and contribute to method statement review and approval processes. 15% Programme & Productivity Support Support planning teams in developing practical construction sequences, accurate activity durations, resource loading, and key project constraints. Identify opportunities to enhance productivity, improve efficiencies, and optimize construction approaches. Monitor site execution to ensure alignment with approved methodologies and recommend corrective actions or improved methods as necessary. 10% Leadership, Capability & Continuous Improvement Lead, mentor, and develop the Methods Engineering team, Temporary Works Coordinator, and Technical Coordinators, establishing clear performance expectations and accountability. Implement consistent engineering and design management practices across disciplines and projects within ABCC. Foster a strong culture of constructability, risk awareness, and disciplined design governance. Capture lessons learned and drove continuous improvement in design delivery, coordination processes, and overall engineering performance. WORK CONTACTS Internal External Technical Director Client / PMC Representatives Senior Design Manager Lead Design Consultant Design Managers (All Disciplines) Specialist Subcontractors Construction / Operations Team Temporary Works Designers Planning / Project Controls Team Lifting Specialists and Method Consultants BIM / Digital Engineering Team Authorities Having Jurisdiction (as required) QA/QC Team HSE Team Temporary Works Coordinator WORKING CONDITIONS Working Environment Site & Site office Degree of Risk - Physical Low to Medium Risk JOB SPECIFICATIONS Industry / Domain Design & Build construction projects with complex site execution, logistics, and temporary works requirements. Large-scale projects require advanced construction methodology and sequencing leadership. Necessary Knowledge and Experience Minimum 12-15+ years of experience in construction methodology, site engineering, or methods management on major projects. Proven experience developing and implementing complex construction methods and sequencing strategies. Strong understanding of temporary works, heavy lifting, steel structure erection, logistics, and specialist construction techniques. Demonstrated experience interfacing with design, planning, BIM, and construction teams. Strong professional proficiency in English, written and spoken. Education and Certification Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering Master’s degree is an advantage. Professional engineering is an advantage. Job Specific and Technical Skills Demonstrated expertise in construction methodology leadership and execution planning. Strong knowledge of applicable civil engineering codes, standards, and regulatory requirements. Proven ability to translate design intent into safe, practical, and efficient construction methodologies. Solid understanding of temporary works design, construction sequencing, and constructability risk management. Experience in leading methodology reviews, technical briefings, and effective site implementation. Excellent communication and leadership skills to influence and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams.

5466091d8de78cda.description: About the Role Front End Limited Company is seeking a Senior Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Analyst to join its team in Al Khobar. This full-time role involves partnering with leadership to drive financial planning, forecasting, and strategic decision-making within a fast-growing, project-driven business. The successful candidate will manage the budgeting cycle, develop financial models, and translate complex data into actionable insights for investment, pricing, and scaling strategies. The finance team is expected to leverage AI tools for enhanced speed, depth of analysis, and sharper insights, consistent with the company's focus on AI and automation. Key Responsibilities Lead annual budgeting and quarterly reforecasting processes, collaborating with business unit and project leads across sectors. Develop and maintain financial models for revenue forecasting, project profitability, cash flow, and long-range planning. Prepare monthly management reporting packs, including variance analysis (budget vs. actual), KPI dashboards, and executive commentary for leadership. Utilize AI tools for analysis, forecasting, reporting automation, and scenario modeling, promoting their adoption within the finance function. Conduct project-level cost analysis and margin tracking across a portfolio of industrial and technology projects. Support business development with pricing analysis, bid financial modeling, and scenario/sensitivity analysis for new contracts and strategic alliances. Drive working capital analysis, encompassing receivables, project billing milestones, and cash forecasting. Evaluate capital expenditure requests and investment cases, including ROI and payback analysis. Collaborate with accounting to ensure alignment between actuals, forecasts, and reporting, and support month-end close reviews. Continuously enhance FP&A processes, automation, and tooling in line with the company's culture of innovation and agility. Mentor junior finance team members and advocate for best practices in financial analysis. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in financial planning and analysis. Strong familiarity with the Saudi market, including local business practices, the regulatory and tax environment (Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority requirements), and the Vision 2030 economic landscape. Demonstrated hands-on use of AI tools (*, large language models, AI-assisted analytics, automation platforms) in daily finance work, with a commitment to continuous learning as technology evolves. Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modeling skills. Experience with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar) and business intelligence (BI) tools (Power BI, Tableau). Strong understanding of project accounting, percentage-of-completion revenue recognition, and working capital dynamics. Proven ability to clearly present financial insights to senior, non-finance stakeholders. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a technology company that emphasizes AI and automation in its operations, including within the finance function. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

54827a1387bda1e6.description: About the Role FNRCO is seeking a Reefer Technician to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on the inspection, maintenance, and repair of refrigerated containers to ensure their optimal operational status. Key Responsibilities Inspect refrigerated containers during receiving, yard storage, and operational periods. Connect and disconnect reefer containers to/from the terminal power supply as per operating procedures. Monitor reefer temperature, set point, return-air temperature, supply-air temperature, alarms, and operating status. Identify and respond to reefer alarms, temperature deviations, power failures, and equipment faults. Troubleshoot refrigeration, electrical, electronic, and control-system problems. Diagnose faults involving compressors, condenser/evaporator fans, sensors, controllers, contactors, relays, evaporators, condensers, and power-supply systems. Perform preventive maintenance and corrective repairs on reefer units. Check refrigerant pressure and identify possible refrigerant leakage. Carry out electrical testing and component replacement as required. Verify reefer performance after repair before returning the unit to operational status. Record reefer inspection results, alarms, repairs, parts replaced, and unit status. Coordinate with reefer operations and yard personnel regarding container availability and access. Prioritize critical reefer faults involving temperature-sensitive cargo and immediately escalate unresolved issues. Maintain reefer maintenance tools, test equipment, and spare parts. Follow refrigerant-handling, electrical isolation, environmental, PPE, and terminal HSE procedures. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this position should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in reefer maintenance and repair. A strong understanding of refrigeration, electrical, and control systems is essential for effective troubleshooting and diagnostics. Work Environment and Practices The role involves working in a dynamic environment, requiring adherence to strict safety and operational protocols. The Reefer Technician will be responsible for maintaining tools and equipment, and for ensuring all work is conducted in compliance with environmental, PPE, and terminal HSE procedures. Location This full-time position is based in the Makkah region, with operational duties in both Jeddah and Makkah. Application Process FNRCO offers a competitive opportunity for qualified professionals. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

548458a8f0c62248.description: نبذة عن مهندس مدني تبحث الموئل للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، الظهران. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة الإشراف على المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات الإنشائية، ومتابعة تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. ملخص الدور يتضمن الدور مسؤولية الإشراف الكامل على الجوانب الإنشائية للمشاريع، بدءاً من دراسة المتطلبات المعمارية وتحليل التربة، وصولاً إلى إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية وتدقيق المخططات وجداول الكميات. كما يشمل الإشراف المباشر على التنفيذ لضمان الجودة والالتزام بالمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية المعتمدة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف المباشر على الموقع الإنشائي ومراجعة نتائج اختبارات فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع، وتحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة. إجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصر المشروع. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات الخاصة بالمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشروع والتأكد من مطابقته للمواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على الإشراف على المواقع الإنشائية وإدارة المشاريع. معرفة قوية بإعداد التصاميم الإنشائية والمخططات وجداول الكميات. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق الموئل للاستشارات الهندسية في الظهران بالمنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الإشراف الميداني والتنسيق المستمر مع مختلف الأطراف المعنية بالمشاريع الإنشائية. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وسيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية.

The position focuses on ensuring that all procurement processes align with project specifications and organizational procedures. Coordinate procurement activities for infrastructure development projects. Evaluate technical proposals submitted by contractors and suppliers. Support tender evaluations, technical comparisons, and contract award recommendations. Coordinate with civil, architectural, and infrastructure teams to ensure design compatibility. 5408123f441d6430.description: Job description Company Description Work with Us. Change the World. At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. Job Description Performs specific and moderate portions of a broader assignment of an experienced engineer. Gathers and correlates basic engineering data using established and well-defined procedures. Works on detailed or routine engineering assignments involving calculations and relatively simple tests. Proposes approach to solve new problems encountered using modifications of standard procedures or methods developed in previous assignments. Identifies discrepancies in results and recommends corrective actions. Provides guidance and mentorship to entry level engineers on technical concepts and best practices. Performs work in accordance with agreed upon budget and schedule with little supervision. Independently performs all the tasks necessary to complete primary design elements for engineering works. Develops and maintains comprehensive technical documentation, including design specifications, test reports, and system analyses. Collaborates with cross-functional teams including project managers, quality assurance specialists, and other engineering disciplines to ensure project objectives are met. Conducts quality assurance reviews and oversees testing protocols to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements. Troubleshoots complex instrumentation and control system issues, implementing solutions that optimize system performance and reliability. Participates in design reviews and provides technical recommendations to improve system efficiency, safety, and cost-effectiveness. Performance at this level requires developmental experience in a professional position. Qualifications **Required Qualifications:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Controls Engineering, or related engineering discipline Minimum 5-7 years of professional engineering experience in instrumentation and control systems design, implementation, or maintenance Demonstrated expertise in troubleshooting and optimizing complex ICT and instrumentation systems Strong proficiency in developing technical documentation, including design specifications, test reports, and system analyses Solid understanding of industry standards and regulatory requirements applicable to instrumentation and control systems Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple engineering assignments within budget and schedule constraints Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to junior engineers Excellent communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams Proficiency in engineering design tools and software relevant to instrumentation and controls **Preferred Qualifications:** Master's degree in Engineering or related field Professional Engineering (PE) license or Engineer in Training (EIT) certification Experience with design review processes and quality assurance protocols Familiarity with project management methodologies Knowledge of automation and control system platforms Experience in a regulated industry environment Additional Information At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment. About AECOM AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com. What makes AECOM a great place to work You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

547432e1e2d1bb77.description: About the Role Nahdi Medical Co. is seeking a Family Dentistry Registrar to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and involves diagnosing and treating injuries or illnesses within the Family Dentistry department. The Registrar will be responsible for patient examinations, medical histories, medication prescriptions, and interpreting diagnostic tests. Key Responsibilities Assess patients and accurately document findings. Design and execute comprehensive patient care plans. Educate patients on their health conditions, required investigations, treatment options, and medication use. Provide patient education on health promotion and disease prevention. Order and review results of patient investigations. Prescribe medications for patients as appropriate. Fulfill all obligations related to patient records. Integrate population factors such as heritage, environment, and disease prevalence into patient care. Perform additional tasks based on specialty and clinical privileges, adhering to Saudi health council guidelines. Compliance and Professional Development Adhere to all Nahdi Care Clinics (NCC) Policies and Procedures (P&P), Bylaws, Strategic Plan, Rules & Regulations. Comply with the mission, vision, goals, and practice guidelines of NCC. Actively participate in assigned NCC Committees and Task Forces. Adhere to CBAHI standards of care. Establish and maintain effective working relationships with other NCC departments, local agencies, vendors, patients, and their families. Complete fire safety requirements and comply with clinical and departmental structure standards, including attendance. Participate in continuous quality improvement activities and ensure compliance with Clinical, MOH, and CBAHI quality standards. Contribute to the continuous professional development of junior staff. Maintain an evidence-based approach in practice. Develop, participate in, and support active Continuing Medical Education programs for the assigned Section, Department, or Clinic, as directed by the chairman. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in family dentistry. Specific privileges will be based on training, experience, skills, and adherence to the guidelines of the Saudi health council. Work Environment This role is primarily based indoors (100%). The work schedule consists of 6 working days per week, with 1 day off. Working hours are 8 net hours per day, according to a shift schedule approved by the head of the department.

549e68e202f69bfe.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة مصطفى جميل للدعاية والاعلان عن مدير إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على الأنشطة الإدارية وضمان سير العمليات اليومية بكفاءة وفعالية عالية، بما يتماشى مع الأهداف التشغيلية المعتمدة للمؤسسة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في صياغة الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، وتطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج والمشاريع التي تدعم تحقيق هذه الأهداف. الإشراف على عمليات تطوير ومراجعة جداول الصلاحيات الإدارية والإجراءات المتبعة، بهدف تحسينها وضمان جودة وسرعة الخدمات الإدارية. متابعة وتوجيه أنشطة تلبية احتياجات الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين من الخدمات الإدارية المتنوعة، مثل النقل والضيافة والنظافة وتنظيم المراسلات والأرشفة والتشغيل الإداري للمرافق. ضمان تطبيق الأنظمة والتعليمات والقرارات الإدارية الصادرة عن الإدارة العليا، ومتابعة تنفيذها بعد إبلاغ الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين بها. الإشراف على إعداد الملخصات والتقارير الدورية التي توضح نسب الإنجاز في الشؤون الإدارية، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا مع إحاطتهم بالتحديات والمستجدات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الإدارة أو الشؤون الإدارية. القدرة على تخطيط وتنظيم الأعمال الإدارية بكفاءة. مهارات متابعة العمليات الإدارية وضمان توافر الموارد اللازمة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن مؤسسة مصطفى جميل للدعاية والاعلان. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع مختلف الوحدات التنظيمية والإدارة العليا لضمان تحقيق الأهداف الإدارية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

54d70df6fbaf8ef6.description: About Saipem Saipem is a global leader in engineering and construction, focusing on the energy and infrastructure sectors. The company delivers complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide, driven by technological innovation. With 30,000 employees from over 130 nationalities across more than 50 countries, Saipem is committed to enabling the energy transition toward Net Zero and shaping the future of environmental sustainability. The Role of Online Surveyor Saipem is seeking an Online Surveyor to join its Offshore Operations within the Survey Scope. This full-time position is based in Dhahran, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia, and requires 2-5 years of experience. The Online Surveyor will be responsible for supporting survey activities, ensuring the proper functioning and quality control of survey and positioning systems. Key Responsibilities Operate online survey software and hardware, ensuring correct system configuration. Support the installation and verification of survey and positioning systems. Perform quality control on positioning and data acquisition systems. Manage survey data acquisition, logging, backup, and reporting activities. Conduct calibration and validation of survey systems. Maintain accurate survey logs, operational records, and field reports. Ensure compliance with project specifications, company (End Client) procedures, and HSE requirements. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in online surveying. The role requires a strong understanding of survey software and hardware operations, as well as experience in data acquisition, quality control, and system calibration. Some travel within KSA is expected for this position. Benefits and Career Development Saipem offers a permanent contract and a comprehensive corporate benefits package. The company supports employee development through its One Saipem Way soft skills model, which focuses on skills development, career growth, and opportunities to innovate through complex challenges by promoting communication and collaboration. Diversity and Sustainability Saipem embraces diversity, believing that innovation thrives through a culture built on mutual respect, collaboration, and inclusion. The company prioritizes safety and sustainability, with a focus on the health and safety of its people and the preservation of natural ecosystems, especially when operating in challenging environments.

541c2cc35c6843b1.description: About Mohammad Al Habib Real Estate Mohammad Al Habib Real Estate is a family-owned company established in 1972, specializing in real estate investments, developments, and master plans. The company focuses on scouting land for urban projects, managing construction details with contractors, and designing commercial and residential communities in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Role of Contracts Engineer The Contracts Engineer will be responsible for the comprehensive management, review, and administration of contracts pertaining to construction projects. This full-time role ensures adherence to contractual terms, provides essential commercial and contractual support to project teams, and actively works to mitigate risks, thereby safeguarding the company's interests. Key Responsibilities Prepare, review, and administer contracts, subcontracts, and related documentation in accordance with company policies and project requirements. Analyze contract terms and conditions to identify potential risks, obligations, and opportunities. Assist in drafting tender documents, bids, proposals, and contract agreements. Provide support during contract negotiations with clients, consultants, and subcontractors. Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, project timelines, and cost control measures. Monitor contract performance, variations, claims, and potential disputes. Prepare and review claims, extensions of time (EOT), and other contractual correspondences. Coordinate with project managers, engineers, and finance teams to ensure alignment of contractual and commercial matters. Maintain accurate records of all contract-related documents, correspondences, and reports. Support management in dispute resolution and the settlement of claims. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 8-10 years of relevant experience in contracts engineering or a similar role within the construction or real estate sector. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a goal-oriented approach, perseverance, self-motivation, and ambition. Required Competencies Strong attention to detail and accuracy in contract review. Excellent organizational and time management skills. Proven problem-solving and risk management abilities. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. High level of professional integrity and discretion in handling confidential information. Strong interpersonal skills with a people-oriented approach. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role offers an environment where individual effort directly impacts outcomes, providing autonomy and opportunities for professional growth within the company.

54512b0ed0cf54fc.description: About the Role Tawuniya is seeking a Manager Medical Claims to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves processing and evaluating medical claims efficiently and accurately, ensuring compliance with coverage scopes, provider contracts, and regulatory requirements while maintaining quality and turnaround-time standards. Key Responsibilities Apply Claims Department policies, procedures, and quality standards consistently. Process assigned claims efficiently, adhering to agreed turnaround times (TAT) and Service Level Agreements (SLA) for all batches from creation to closing. Manage internal and external email communications professionally, following established email etiquette and SLAs. Ensure all adjudication decisions comply with CCHI regulations, Insurance Authority requirements, and Tawuniya's internal policies. Review internal quality-review findings, address identified gaps, and implement agreed corrective actions. Contribute to the training and development of claims staff by sharing medical knowledge and processing guidelines. Provide structured feedback on system limitations, operational process gaps, and opportunities for improvement. Support data-driven claims management and healthcare value initiatives, including VBHC, DRG, and PHM, to identify utilization trends, improve care quality and appropriateness, optimize healthcare costs, and support continuous improvement. Provide medical claims data analysis to identify utilization patterns, cost drivers, abnormal trends, and potential areas of leakage or overutilization. Deliver assigned Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and drive continuous improvement through quarterly Kaizen initiatives and One Point Lessons (OPLs). Pursue individual technical, personal, and medical skills development in line with the agreed capability-building plan. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in medical claims processing and management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

546cc9c90c5d7793.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is a CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) company focused on business communication. The team consists of over 400 individuals dedicated to serving more than 5000 customer-centric companies. Unifonic fosters a collaborative work environment that encourages creativity and new ideas. The Role of Customer Solutions Consultant As a Customer Solutions Consultant based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, you will assist customers in achieving digital transformation through cloud communication. This full-time role involves leading collaboration with virtual teams including sales, engineers, and support resources. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. You will be responsible for building and maintaining strong customer relationships, influencing long-term strategic direction, and serving as a trusted advisor. This includes driving executive-level engagement with CXOs and technology decision-makers, evaluating cloud communication strategies, recommending solutions aligned with business and technical requirements, removing deployment roadblocks, and ensuring successful adoption while driving customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Act as a technical liaison between Sales and Product teams during the sales process, supporting solution design, quotes, proposals, RFP responses, and related documentation. Develop working knowledge of Unifonic's conversational AI and omnichannel communications platform. Participate in Sales team meetings to understand customer pain points, requirements, and business goals, and help shape relevant solutions. Support problem escalation and best-practice efforts to help clients and internal teams use Unifonic's products effectively. Build and deliver product demos and pilots that showcase Unifonic's value to prospects and clients. Relay timely, organized client feedback to Product Management, Sales, Support, and Development based on real business cases. Hand off won deals to the Customer Success team with clear context on customer goals and configuration. Support Sales and Account Management on upsell and cross-sell opportunities with technical input. Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Product, Support, Engineering) as needed to close deals. Required Qualifications Ability to create a positive customer experience by matching product/service offerings to customer needs. Ability to understand and troubleshoot customer needs and translate them into workable solutions. Strong interpersonal skills, comfortable engaging multiple stakeholders and collaborating with virtual/cross-functional teams. Desired Character Traits Analytical thinking and problem-solving: approaching problems clearly, using data, and finding solutions. Ownership and accountability: taking responsibility and following projects through to completion. Communication: explaining ideas clearly and listening to others across teams. Collaboration: working well with others and supporting team goals. Adaptability and learning: adjusting to change and continuously acquiring new skills or tools. Mentorship and knowledge sharing: helping others grow and sharing expertise. Resilience: maintaining composure under pressure and handling setbacks constructively. Quality and attention to detail: performing work carefully and striving for improvement. Advocacy and innovation: encouraging best practices, efficiency, and new ideas. The Sales Team The Sales team at Unifonic focuses on driving revenue while acting as trusted consultants to customers. The team includes experts in account management, business development, and customer service, who work closely with other departments to ensure products and services meet customer needs.

548d19e1b3a4e403.description: About the Role AWS EMEA SARL (Saudi Arabia Branch) is seeking a Business Development Manager, Oil & Gas, to join its Energy team. This full-time role is based in Riyadh or Dammam and focuses on the intersection of cloud technology and the energy industry in the Middle East. The manager will support major energy companies in modernizing operations and accelerating digital transformation across the region. Role Context and Focus The Business Development Manager will own the regional strategy for energy in the Middle East, identifying opportunities where data and AI can generate insights and accelerate value across the energy chain. The role involves understanding the full energy landscape, from exploration and production to refining, petrochemicals, pipelines, and LNG. This position requires engaging with VP-level engineering and digital leaders to shape solutions, develop reference architectures, and drive complex pursuits from initial contact to signed deals. The manager will operate with autonomy, building a pipeline and collaborating with AWS account teams, ISVs, and systems integrators. Key Responsibilities Develop and manage a global go-to-market strategy for the midstream and downstream energy segment, identifying priority use cases and customer targets. Engage VP and C-level leaders at major mid/downstream companies, building advisory relationships and connecting operational challenges with AWS solutions. Create and deliver technical content, including whitepapers, reference architectures, and solution briefs for use cases such as digital twins and carbon management. Collaborate with partners, customer account teams, and industry deployment and systems integrators to co-develop solutions for refining and pipeline operations. Identify and qualify new business opportunities with energy customers in the Middle East, developing and executing strategies aligned with regional priorities. Build and deliver technical presentations, workshops, and proof-of-concept demonstrations tailored to energy industry use cases. Develop and maintain a robust pipeline, tracking progress and providing accurate forecasts to leadership. Represent AWS Energy at regional industry events, conferences, and executive briefings. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree. 5+ years of experience in developing, negotiating, and executing business agreements. 5+ years of experience in solving problems with technology within the Energy & Utilities industries. 5+ years of professional or military experience, with 5+ years in Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting. Experience working with and presenting complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executives, and developing strategies that influence organizational-level leadership decisions. Experience with Data & AI technologies (AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage) and Advanced Compute technologies (Accelerated Compute, HPC, Visual/Spatial Compute, and/or IoT). Preferred Qualifications Master's degree in business economics, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, information technology, or equivalent. Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations. Experience and Skills Candidates should possess direct experience within the energy industry, understanding operational aspects from drilling rigs and control rooms to plant floors, or involvement in digital transformation programs. Knowledge of DCS, historians, OSDU, reservoir management, turnaround planning, and pipeline SCADA modernization is beneficial. The role requires operational credibility, commercial instincts, and the drive to support energy companies in the Middle East with AWS solutions.

Key Responsibilities Engage with staff, managers, and stakeholders on operational HR matters, supporting local HR strategy and initiatives in ER, L&D, Performance Management, and Employee Engagement. Promote the Savills brand and support initiatives to enhance the Employer Proposition and Global Branding. Lead local talent acquisition activities in conjunction with the regional Talent Acquisition team, ensuring alignment with recruitment practices and company processes. Manage the CV screening, interview, and selection process for new hires, implementing talent screening processes such as technical competency and psychometric assessments. Oversee the end-to-end recruitment process for KSA, utilizing company software and recruitment portals for efficiency and regular vacancy updates. Review and enhance joiner and leaver processes, utilizing HR analytics for management reporting. Collaborate with Marketing, IT, Compliance, and Finance teams to ensure alignment and support HR projects. Manage the development and delivery of the staff induction program, reviewing it periodically for improvements. Ensure proper implementation of performance management processes during probationary periods, following up with line managers and employees. Assist in the delivery and planning of training arrangements and support e-learning provisions. Work on ad-hoc HR projects and operational improvement tasks. Act as a point of contact for employee relations, addressing concerns and promoting a positive work environment. Assist with reporting and analytics for plc, local country, or regional levels. Conduct investigations into employee complaints and grievances, ensuring confidentiality and fair outcomes. Escalate complex employee relations issues to the Head of HR and assist with cases. Advise managers on probationary reviews, extensions, and contract renewals. Assist with annual appraisal and promotion processes. Liaise with the Training Development Manager and Head of HR to identify employee training needs. Manage the full operational visa process for new joiners, renewals, and leavers, escalating issues to the Head of HR as needed. Work with managers to ensure smooth onboarding and assist in induction program delivery. Collaborate with the Head of HR on improving onboarding and offboarding processes. Ensure data integrity and accuracy on internal systems and improve team use of systems and efficiency tools. Follow up with the GRO regarding licenses, portals, regulations, medical insurance, iqama issuance/renewal, and other insurance matters. Experience in managing employee relations casework. Proficiency in talent acquisition and talent management processes. Familiarity with HR analytics and reporting. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Savills Middle East team. The role requires collaboration with various internal departments and regional HR teams.

Since its establishment in 1999 with the opening of Jumeirah Burj Al Arab, the brand has been recognized for its beachfront resorts, city hotels, and residences. 54b00cfc514c244a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الجميح للسيارات عن مراقب كاميرات أمنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف الفعال على عمليات كاميرات المراقبة الأمنية، وتشغيل أنظمة المراقبة، والاستجابة السريعة لحالات الطوارئ الأمنية على مدار الساعة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على عمليات كاميرات المراقبة الأمنية والتعامل مع حالات الإنذار وطوارئ الحرائق والتحقيق فيها، مع ضمان الاستجابة الفورية على مدار الساعة. تشغيل أنظمة الإنذار وكاميرات المراقبة ومراقبتها وصيانتها بشكل دوري. تنزيل وإدارة التسجيلات الأمنية لاستخدامها في التحقيقات المستقبلية، مع ضمان الامتثال لقواعد ولوائح خصوصية البيانات. التحقيق في الحالات الطارئة وأي انتهاكات للسياسات والإجراءات الأمنية المعتمدة. اتباع السياسات والإجراءات الأمنية التي تتوافق مع القوانين واللوائح المعمول بها، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالمشكلات فور حدوثها. رفع التقارير الدورية للإدارة حول أسباب ونتائج الحوادث، وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة لمسار العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مراقبة الكاميرات الأمنية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية في بيئة تتطلب اليقظة والاستجابة السريعة. فهم جيد لأنظمة المراقبة الأمنية وإجراءات الطوارئ. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في الملاحظة والتحليل. القدرة على اتخاذ قرارات سريعة وفعالة تحت الضغط. مهارات تواصل جيدة لتقديم التقارير والإبلاغ عن المشكلات. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الأمنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب التواجد في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتضمن العمل التعامل مع حالات الطوارئ الأمنية والاستجابة لها على مدار الساعة، مما يتطلب مستوى عالٍ من اليقظة والمسؤولية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

54ec7ed888fbc487.description: About the Role Modern Mills Company is seeking an Assistant Manager Costing to join their team in Makkah, specifically in Al Jumum. This full-time role supports the management of product costing, inventory valuation, production and maintenance order costing, budgeting, and month-end closing activities. The position ensures the accuracy of standard and actual costs, investigates manufacturing and inventory variances, and provides reliable financial information for operational and management decision-making. Role Context and Collaboration The Assistant Manager Costing works closely with various departments including Production, Maintenance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Quality, Information Technology, and Finance teams. This collaboration is essential to ensure that all manufacturing transactions are accurately recorded, allocated, analyzed, and reported, contributing to effective cost control across the company's operations. Key Responsibilities Manage product, production, process, maintenance, subcontracting, and inventory costing activities to ensure accurate cost allocation and reporting. Review purchase orders, material costs, landed costs, inventory movements, and budget consumption, investigating significant pricing and quantity variances. Monitor production orders, material usage, labor, yield, waste, scrap, rework, and overhead costs, identifying root causes and recommending corrective actions. Review maintenance and subcontracting costs, material consumption, stock balances, and order settlements to ensure accurate accounting and timely closure. Oversee inventory valuation, provisions, physical counts, stock transfers, slow-moving/obsolete inventory, and inventory reconciliations. Coordinate standard costing cycles, including BOMs, routings, production versions, costing runs, cost roll-ups, and standard cost updates in SAP. Lead costing activities during month-end close, including cost allocations, activity rates, order settlement, variance analysis, journal entries, and reconciliation of costing, inventory, and GL balances. Support annual budgeting, forecasting, cost baselines, expenditure monitoring, and analysis of budget-to-actual variances. Prepare new product cost estimates and provide cost analysis to support pricing, profitability, make-or-buy, and investment decisions. Develop costing reports, dashboards, and management analyses, ensuring data accuracy and supporting SAP and finance-system improvements. Support internal and external audits and ensure compliance with accounting policies, internal controls, procedures, and approval requirements. Identify cost-reduction and process-improvement opportunities and provide financial insights to Production, Procurement, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other business functions. Provide technical guidance, coaching, and work review for Costing team members and ensure timely completion of assigned activities. Company Culture and Environment Modern Mills Company offers a work environment focused on career growth and learning through structured training, mentorship, and cross-functional development. Employees contribute to initiatives supporting food security, sustainability, and digital transformation within an inclusive culture that values teamwork and collaboration. The company provides a competitive salary, comprehensive medical and life insurance, health benefits, and programs designed to support work-life balance. There is also access to advanced technology, process automation, and modern operations that drive operational excellence. Application Process Candidates interested in this full-time Assistant Manager Costing position are encouraged to apply. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry.

547a08ef6aa23380.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة النجم الخليجيه الذهبية عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في سيهات، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ وتقييم السياسات التسويقية للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى إجراء اختبارات السوق وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد أسباب نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات تسعير تنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج واختيار قنوات التوزيع وتقييم فعالية الحملات الدعائية والإعلانية. وضع برنامج زمني لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المنتجات والأسعار. القدرة على استخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة النجم الخليجيه الذهبية في سيهات، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التزامًا بالإشراف على تنفيذ السياسات التسويقية وتقييمها بشكل مستمر. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم وفقًا للإجراءات المعتمدة.

Setting sales strategies for products aligned with geographical strategy and identifying/closing sales leads. Supplying market intelligence to product developers and managers to support design, development, and implementation efforts. 54a557ac30ae26d6.description: About the company Our client does AI match analysis for youth football. Fixed cameras at the pitch record every session. The models detect the events (passes, shots, goals), track the players, and read jersey numbers off low-res footage. Academies and parents get match stats, highlights and a per-player record. This is running today at a pilot academy in Dubai, on real matches, with paying pilots. They are now taking the same stack into a second industry. First customers are committed; details in conversation. This hire owns the platform across both: making the live sports models better, and building the new product on the same foundations. What you own • The shared CV platform, end to end: camera ingestion, detection and tracking, OCR, classification, and the reporting pipeline. It powers a product in production today and a second one launching. • From week one you ship to a live product: raising accuracy on the sports models with real users, while architecting the second industry's deployment on the same stack. • Architecture: model selection and training strategy, annotation and dataset operations, evaluation methodology, the on-prem/cloud split. • Shipping the new industry's first deployments, then hardening both products as one platform. • Technical leadership of the engineering team we build under you. Hiring process • Intro conversation: walk us through a CV system you built. Decisions, failures, numbers. • Technical deep-dive with senior engineers. • Case study on real footage: spec and prototype a detection task. • Founders' conversation, then offer. The whole process inside two weeks for the right person What we need to see • 5+ years building computer vision systems that ran in production. Deployed systems with users, not notebooks. • Strong Python and PyTorch, hands-on with modern detection and tracking (YOLO family, ByteTrack/DeepSORT or similar). • Video pipeline experience: RTSP/IP cameras, scheduled or streaming inference, ffmpeg-level fluency. • You have built datasets, run annotation operations, and measured models honestly against ground truth. • You have fine-tuned open-source models (detection, OCR of the PaddleOCR/TrOCR class) and taken the next step: replacing them with your own models trained on validated annotations, with a working annotation-review loop. • Fluent in the modern CV tooling ecosystem: Roboflow or equivalent for dataset and annotation operations, experiment tracking, model registries. • Ownership temperament: you take a vague operational goal and return a working system without waiting for a spec. Strong pluses • OCR, action recognition or pose estimation in production. • Sports, retail, industrial or facility camera-analytics background. • Edge deployment (Jetson or similar) and cost engineering of inference. • Camera and IoT literacy: sensor and lens selection, PoE networking, ONVIF/RTSP, NVRs, weatherproof housings. You can spec a site, not just a model. Full-time. Remote friendly: we hire the best person, not the nearest. Working hours overlapping the Gulf, with travel to Dubai for installation and milestone weeks. Competitive package plus options.

543a6b2b1e0c3c55.description: Job Summary: The Lead Planner is responsible for developing, maintaining, and reporting the project schedule for ABICON's scope of work, coordinating progress measurement and ensuring schedule risks are identified and communicated to project management. 54de65bc610d2ad2.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth. Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalized experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value. Why This Role Matters Lucidya is entering a new phase of growth. As we continue to scale our commercial teams, expand our graduate hiring initiatives, and strengthen our presence across the Saudi talent market, the quality of the people we bring into the company will directly shape our future. This role is about much more than filling vacancies. As Talent Acquisition Lead, you'll play a key role in building the next generation of Lucidya talent. You'll help define how candidates experience our company, how future employees learn about our culture, and how we attract people who will raise the bar for everyone around them. You'll be the bridge between Lucidya and the talent market - representing our values, building relationships with universities, identifying high-potential graduates, and ensuring every candidate interaction reflects the kind of company we're striving to become. Success in this role means consistently attracting exceptional talent while creating a hiring experience that candidates remember for the right reasons. You'll help shape a culture where great people want to join, grow, and do the best work of their careers What You'll Do Build talent pipelines that fuel Lucidya's growth You'll partner closely with leaders across Sales, Customer Experience, Strategy & Performance, and other business functions to understand hiring needs and proactively build pipelines before roles become urgent. Rather than reacting to vacancies, you'll help the business stay ahead of its talent needs. Become the face of Lucidya for emerging talent You'll build strong partnerships with universities, student organizations, and graduate communities across Saudi Arabia. Whether you're presenting at a career fair, leading a campus event, or hosting students at Lucidya, you'll tell the story of who we are, what we believe in, and why ambitious graduates should build their careers with us. Design a graduate hiring experience that identifies future leaders You'll own recruitment for our graduate programs and assessment centers, creating structured processes that help us identify potential, not just experience. You'll continuously refine how we assess candidates to ensure we're selecting individuals who can thrive in a high-performance, high-growth environment. Create an exceptional candidate experience You'll ensure every candidate receives a professional, transparent, and engaging experience throughout the hiring process. You'll understand that every interaction shapes our employer brand, regardless of whether a candidate ultimately joins Lucidya. Help strengthen culture through hiring You'll partner with hiring managers to define what great talent looks like beyond technical skills. You'll help us consistently hire people who demonstrate curiosity, ownership, collaboration, learning agility, and a genuine desire to contribute to a positive culture. Improve how we hire and onboard You'll continuously look for opportunities to improve recruitment and onboarding processes. You'll use data, feedback, and candidate insights to identify bottlenecks, improve hiring quality, and create a smoother transition from candidate to employee. Measure what matters You'll track hiring performance through metrics such as time-to-hire, quality-of-hire, candidate satisfaction, pipeline health, and hiring manager satisfaction.
